title: Tierllama engine manifest
description: Schema for declaring a local inference engine as data (J12+ T4). Inspired by NVIDIA Personal-AI-Router engine-manager manifests (Apache-2.0). Adding an engine to Tierllama is a manifest file in engines/, not code.

name.description: Unique engine id (kebab-case). One manifest per engine.

kind.description: Dialect family the engine speaks; maps to the adapters' dispatch path.

detect.description: How to recognize an already-running instance (optional; auto-detection itself is NOT implemented yet - schema-only per J12+ scope).

runtime.description: How Tierllama would start/stop the engine (loader stub only in this milestone).

start_command.description: Argv template; {port} and {bind} placeholders are substituted.

actions.description: Optional engine actions; null means 'engine does not support this'.

metadata.description: Free-form: attribution, notes. Keep inspired_by filled when a pattern was ported.
